title: Branch at the end of a borrow pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k$ work tapes, let $a \in \bbn$, and let $x$ be an input word over the schedule alphabet. Take a base configuration on $x$, a position $p$ for its input head, integers $u,g$, a bit word $w$, schedule-tape contents $\mu,\gamma$, and a Boolean carry flag. In the configuration built from these data with controller state the borrow phase, budget head at $|w|+1$, and budget tape equal to the captured clock tape of $w$, one step leaves every tape, head position, and other configuration component unchanged, and changes the controller state to unary-start if the carry flag is true and budget-start otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
x is an input word over the schedule alphabet
base is a configuration on x
p is a valid input-head position
μ and γ are schedule-tape contents indexed by integers
controller begins in the borrow phase
budget tape is the captured clock tape of w
replaced:
From a setup configuration in the borrow phase with flag $c$ and budget head at cell
$|w|+1$ (the blank cell after the captured clock tape of the bit word $w$), one step
keeps every tape and head fixed and moves to the unary-start phase when $c$ is true
(the budget underflowed, i.e.\ is exhausted) and back to the budget-start phase
otherwise.
